- Cite EVERY non-obvious claim as file:line. Prefer ACTUAL CONFIGURED VALUES over prose (real numbers: model dims, layer counts, vocab, seq len, step budgets, seeds, tile sizes, register counts).

- The "prompt_contradictions" field is load-bearing: list anywhere the SuperGrok2 prompt's stated assumptions disagree with the live code. For existing components the CODEBASE WINS; your job is to SURFACE the disagreement, not resolve it.

SUBSYSTEM: compile.py RECONCILE — the SPECIFIC items Phase 2 wants to ADD (Stages 1 & 3). For EACH, determine the TRUE current status (PRESENT/PARTIAL/ABSENT) with file:line, because the prompt scoped these against an OLD snapshot and they may already exist:
- S1.1 Wire SASS audit into the tuning loop: is cuobjdump -sass (profile_maximal.py ~line 285) imported into compile.py's JIT measure path as a post-compile audit hook feeding the cost model? Or standalone only?
- S1.2 Realized-resource (ptxas -v registers/spills/smem) -> occupancy gate that prunes JIT candidates BEFORE timing. Present?
- S1.3 Counter PGO by default on top-K survivors + MEASURED achieved-occupancy/L2/issue-slot/DRAM features in the cost model (vs analytical occupancy_estimate).
- S1.4 cudaAccessPolicyWindow / L2 persistence (cudaLimitPersistingL2CacheSize) as a tuned dim.
- S1.5 cudaFuncAttributePreferredSharedMemoryCarveout / MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize as tuned knobs.
- S3.1 producer/consumer compile-while-benchmark pipeline + speculative precompile + NVRTC/nvJitLink.
- S3.2 artifact lifecycle GC (size-capped LRU/LFU + ref-count pinning) — note 'evict' in code is L2-cache flush, NOT artifact GC.
- S3.3 content-addressable/Merkle build cache.
- S3.4 cross-run negative cache + bloom filter.
Also: assess the PORTABILITY invariant — does compile.py bake in SuperGrok-specific kernel names/shapes, or is it generic/config-driven? cite examples.

Key SuperGrok2-prompt assertions to check against the code (flag any that are wrong):
- "33 megakernels / 33 cells" exist (11 optimizers x 3 models on sm_90).
- "44 -> 99 component architecture".
- "single-source math contract + drift guard" enforced.
- "fused-megakernel substrate": one persistent kernel, fwd->barrier->bwd->barrier->opt, single launch.
- The mod-97 tasks are the CURRENT data; Phase 3 will replace them with FineWeb-Edu (decoder), ImageNet-1k (ViT), GiftEvalPretrain (Mamba).
- evaluate() currently forwards the WHOLE held-out tensor every call (fine at mod-97 ~4656 samples, catastrophic at scale).
- EarlyStopper currently triggers on 95% test accuracy (no analog for LM/forecasting).
- "MultiGPUTimingPool" exists (compile.py:4874) and is the cross-GPU timing pool.
- Parallelism strategy is "already in the codebase" (do not redesign).
